statement: The record indicates that invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291 despite showing an unpaid status, giving a value of 'hold' for this case to prevent duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG

It asserts the "unpaid, due" status contradicts the record's own payment history ("already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291") and that paying would be a duplicate payment.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
